mapper.sql: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.place_kind)) IN ('RESTAURANT','CAFE','MARKET','BEAUTY','ETC') THEN UPPER(TRIM(p.place_kind)) WHEN p.place_kind IN ('관광식당','서양식','일식','중식','기타외국식','김밥 분식','분식', '퓨전음식','이동음식','모범음식점','바/펍') THEN 'RESTAURANT' WHEN p.place_kind IN ('카페','찻집','제과','기타음료점') THEN 'CAFE' WHEN p.place_kind IN ('상설시장','비상설시장','복합쇼핑몰','백화점', '관광기념품/특산물판매점','아웃렛','공방/공예품점') THEN 'MARKET' WHEN p.place_kind = '뷰티매장' THEN 'BEAUTY' ELSE 'ETC' END

SELECT p.place_id, p.place_id AS item_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pt.name), ''), p.name) AS name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pt.brand), ''), p.brand) AS brand, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pt.branch), ''), p.branch) AS branch, p.place_kind, p.thumbnail_url, p.image_urls, p.source_url, p.region1, p.region2, p.region3, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pt.address_display), ''), p.address_road) AS address_road, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pt.address_detail), ''), p.address_detail) AS address_detail, p.postal_code, p.latitude, p.longitude, , , COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pt.menu_summary), ''), p.menu_summary) AS menu_summary, p.tel, p.has_foreign_lang, p.has_parking, p.reservable, p.takeout_available, p.card_payment_available, p.smoke_free, p.kid_facility, p.has_restroom, p.is_active, p.view_count, p.favorite_count,
FROM explore_items ei JOIN place p ON p.place_id = ei.item_id
WHERE ei.item_type = 'PLACE' AND ei.item_id = #{placeId} AND ei.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND ei.visibility_status = 'VISIBLE' AND ei.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.is_active = TRUE

SELECT a.activity_id, a.activity_code, CASE WHEN #{language} = 'en' THEN a.label_en ELSE a.label_ko END AS activity_name, s.sector_id, s.sector_code, CASE WHEN #{language} = 'en' THEN s.label_en ELSE s.label_ko END AS sector_name, pa.is_primary FROM place_activity pa JOIN activity a ON a.activity_id = pa.activity_id JOIN sector s ON s.sector_id = a.sector_id WHERE pa.place_id = #{placeId} AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pa.is_primary DESC, s.display_order, a.display_order, a.activity_id
